paper_title: Search for ultralight dark matter with spectroscopy of radio-frequency atomic transitions
notes: Fig.3a of the paper (Exclusions_3k.pdf, a rasterized figure; extracted by pixel-color tracing of the deep-pink Rb/Quartz curve, calibrated on the labeled decade ticks). ScalarPhoton d_e is the leading scalar coupling (coupling to alpha); the paper reports three scalar couplings d_e,d_me,d_g from Experiment 1 (Rb/quartz frequency comparison) plus a more stringent d_e bound from Experiment 2 (Dy, blue curve) over a narrower range, and a pseudoscalar QCD axion-gluon 1/f_a limit in Fig.4. The Rb/Quartz curve is the paper headline scalar result: its mass span 1e-17-8.3e-13 eV matches the abstract exactly. Limit at 95% C.L.; a factor x4.4 for UBDM stochasticity is already included by the authors. Local UBDM density assumed rho_DM=3e-6 eV^4 = 0.39 GeV/cm^3; scalar-DM limit scales with this density (not rescaled per task card). The stronger Dy d_e curve (down to d_e~1e-3) and the pseudoscalar 1/f_a curve were not chosen as the main result.
